answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents stake tokens into a bonded graph where random multi-agent auditing committees inspect transaction paths. Verifiers compute topological cut verifications across clusters; if an attacker spawns fake identities to echo artificial consensus, the cut sparseness immediately flags the partition. Correlated malicious votes trigger quadratic stake slashing, rendering attack costs superlinear. Genuine agents retain a marble solid ledger, while adversary deposits vanish like a plume of smoke.
